_doc: Oathwild's arena (brainstorm 2026-11-27 §2; owner: 'a new hosting option for waves mode where you go to a massive arena and fight waves of monsters of certain level ranges … gear as rewards via chests … starting it should be possible for a lvl 1 character … Include other heroes in the system with special rewards for defeating them'). Read by js/rules/arena.js (the ONE reader: wave plans, scaling, rewards, uniques, champions, the hero's arena record) and server/arena.js (the match). Heroes are shared with the open world (owner answer 1): everything earned here is the hero's. Champions are made-up (owner answer 2): a ten-rank ladder to a Grand Champion. The place itself (floor, stands, gates, the court) is data/arena/*.json + js/world/arena-place.js.
_goal: THE TUNING GOAL (rule 81, read by tools/sim-arena.mjs and tests/rules/arena.test.mjs). A hero of a bracket's levels (plain kit to level 3, magic finds from 5) clears it alone in 3-7 minutes with abilities and rolls out of a quarter of the tells (the 'new player' bar, --dodge 0.25) in at least 60% of runs and at the average bar (0.5) in at least 75%; a party of three clears it more often than one; a hero two levels under a bracket's floor mostly loses (that is what 'hard' means on the board). A champion bout at the champion's level is a real fight: the average bar wins 60-90% (the Bard, weak everywhere, loses most), and the fight lasts 15-60 s (measured 17-42 s on 2026-11-26).

match._doc: waves: how many a match has. breather: seconds between waves (no shops mid-match). gather: seconds from Start to the first wave (everyone in the arena is walked onto the sand). packGap: seconds between packs inside a wave (they arrive over time, not all at once — owner: packs of 1-2, rarely 3). floorRadius: metres; a hero inside it is in the match. leash: how far from the middle of the floor a monster follows before it gives up (the floor is 60 m across from the middle). aggro: metres a wave monster notices a hero (they come out hunting). breatherHeal: the share of health and mana every hero still standing gets back when a breather starts (the crowd's water-bearers; a lone hero has no healer).

waves._doc: Per wave (1-5): `normals` = ordinary monsters for ONE hero, `brute` = a mini-boss (a tough normal at the brute rank), `boss` = a camp boss of the bracket's regions; `level` = where in the bracket's range its monsters stand (0 = the low end, 1 = the high end). More heroes: normals x (1 + perHero x (heroes - 1)), rounded up (wave 5: the boss alone for one hero, its guards come with a party); the brute and the boss stay one, with more health (scale below).

scale._doc: The ONE place arena monsters are sized for the party (js/rules/arena.js arenaScale; lessons rule 33). hp/dmg at 1 hero; hpPerHero/dmgPerHero added for each hero after the first. Normals stay as the open world's (the newHero numbers for levels 1-4 come from combat.json, untouched). A brute is the 'champion' rank of Farhold's monsters (x2.6 health) brought down for one hero.

brutes._doc: Monsters that make a good mini-boss for wave 3 (any of the bracket's roster that is in this list; otherwise the toughest normal of the roster).

board._doc: How the bracket board marks a bracket for a hero: 'hard' when the hero is more than `hardBelow` levels under its low end (still allowed — owner: not locked), 'easy' when the hero is above its high end (rewards then roll at the bracket's level).

rewards._doc: A reward chest per player after a win (individual loot, the game's rule). gold = goldBase + goldPerLevel x bracket top level, +firstGold on a first clear. items: count per chest; rarity: the weights move toward the good end by `rarityBoost` (normal 60 / magic 30 / rare 9 / legendary 1 at boost 1, data/loot-tables.json) which grows `boostPerBracket` per bracket; a first clear adds one more item and guarantees a magic-or-better piece (minRarity). Items roll at the bracket's top level, or the hero's level if lower (gear you can wear). kinds: what can drop.

champions._doc: The ladder (owner answer 2: made-up champions only; ten ranks to a Grand Champion). Each champion is BUILT LIKE A PLAYER (js/rules/hero-ai.js buildCharacter: the class plan, points, talents, gear of its level and `gear` rarity, and its own unique equipped) and FIGHTS like one (hero-ai.js championInput: its bar, rolls out of hero bolts and ground zones at `dodge`, a red mark for `tell` seconds before any ability with a cooldown of `specialCooldown` s or more). `needs`: the bracket that must be cleared first (and the rank before beaten). `hp` / `dmg`: the champion against ONE hero; `party` adds per extra hero. `title`: what a hero who beats them is called (shown with their name). `unique`: their signature item (uniques below).

lines.greet: Fresh meat! Let's see what the gate let in.
lines.won: Back to the sand with you.
lines.lost: Hah! Fair hit. The crowd likes you.
You closed the gap. Nobody closes the gap.

lines.greet: Blink and you'll miss it. Most do.
I will pray for you after. Briefly.
Fire is honest. Let us be honest.
The wolf in me wants to play.
A song for the crowd! You're the sad verse.
lines.lost: They'll sing about YOU now. Cheek.

lines.greet: Smell the rain? That's for you.
Nobody has walked past me in three seasons.
lines.lost: Then go on. The Grand Champion waits.

lines.greet: Every name on that board came through me. Yours will too, or it won't.
lines.won: Come back when you are ready.
lines.lost: The sand is yours, Grand Champion.

uniques._doc: Each champion's signature item: an Emberveil base (rolled Legendary at `level`, its own damage / armour) with FIXED enchantments (Farhold affix ids, each at `roll` of its range at that level, x `power`) and a name of its own. Marked Unique on the card, with the line `lore`.

garrans_knuckle.name: Garran's Knuckle Shield
garrans_knuckle.lore: Dented by a hundred first fights. Garran never lost the shield, only the fights.

quills_longbow.name: Quill's Longbow
quills_longbow.lore: Marra cut a notch for every champion she dropped from across the sand.

strands_knife.name: Strand's Quick Knife
strands_knife.lore: Light enough to forget it is there. That is the trick.

calloways_mace.name: Calloway's Prayer Mace
calloways_mace.lore: Words of mercy run round the head. She reads them after a fight.

draves_staff.name: Drave's Ash Staff
draves_staff.lore: Blackened from tip to heel, and still warm.

moors_crown.name: Moor's Antler Crown
moors_crown.lore: Shed by a stag that followed Kesta into the arena and never left.

tamsks_pendant.name: Tamsk's Song Pendant
tamsks_pendant.lore: It hums the last bar of every song Lio ever won.

holloways_ring.name: Holloway's Storm Ring
holloways_ring.lore: The air tastes of thunder when you slip it on.

dasks_plate.name: Dask's Sun Plate
dasks_plate.lore: Polished every morning. Corvin says the sun likes to see itself.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.lore: The Grand Champion's own blade. The sand goes quiet when it is drawn.
